answer_1.quote: Given the following sentence, expand it into a 10 sentence story: Sentence: A fallen tree cannot provide shade
answer_1.outputs: stories of varying lengths (1, 10, and 30 sentences)

answer_2.quote: For T 1 (analogies from a small story bank, §3.3) we use accuracy as the primary measure of success... For T 2 (analogy from a large story bank, §3.3), we report common retrieval metrics such as Mean Average Precision (MAP), Precision@K, Recall@K, and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR)

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation to measure whether the task is well-defined and has a reasonable quality. This process was meticulously applied to our T 1 task (Analogy Selection, §3.3) across different levels of complexity: 1-sentence, 10-sentence, and 30-sentence scenarios.
answer_4.guideline: Each annotator began by selecting their personal answer choice without conferring... disagreements were adjudicated via discussion among the annotators... encouraged to exchange their rationales behind their initial selection and converge upon one collective answer
